notes.title: Progress Update (Including Requested GCN Controller support)
notes.content:
A lot of updates were released in the past weeks, I hope you all appreciate the work that has been put into the game since the release. 

I'm happy to announce that Break The Targets has [b]FULL GAMECUBE CONTROLLER DRIVER SUPPORT[/b] with both WiiU and Mayflash adapters. This was by far the most requested feature from reddit users. BTT is also compatible with bluetooth controllers.

The additions and improvements are almost to many to mention, but here are some standouts:
[list]
   
 [*]Rocket mode: A “top-down” perspective, creating an entirely new way to approach familiar stages!

 [*]Various new ways to play SSBM tribute stages, some original and some borrowed from the Smash Stadium community, including: Mode5, Start Anywhere, Flipped Stages, and Unlimited Special Powers!

 [*]Motorbike mode: 20 all new levels and new special items for the Level Builder.

 [*]Greatly improved Level Builder and in-game TAS engine.

 [*]Weekly Community Challenge: a randomly generated and developer selected stage every week that rewards Replay Coins for the top three placements!

 [*]Improved UI to accommodate for all the new content.
[/list]

Have fun breaking targets ! 

-Qual
